name: Emma Jagger
biography: Emma is an extremely personable 8 year old who is super fun to have on set. She takes direction well and has a great work ethic. Emma is also a whiz at memorizing lines! She has primarily done commercials and a few smaller web series/short films and is ready to pursue TV/Film roles. She is currently represented by DDO Kids for Commercial and Print and by Cracker Jack Management for TV/Film. Emma is a great skateboarder, snowboarder, and horseback rider and has been in Scene Study classes for nearly a year.
